notes.title: BATTLEDROID Kickstarter final 48 hours!
notes.content:
WIth just two days left to go, the Battledroid Kickstarter appeal is sat at 98%, just shy of our goal! This is absolutely amazing, and we can't thank everyone enough. We're confident it's going to reach its minimum funding level before everyone buggers off on holiday or has a General Election tomorrow.

What does this mean for you?

This means that Battledroid is going to be released, and has enough funding to ensure that we can add loads of new things into it and keep developing it and shaping it into the sprawling magnum opus that we all hoped it was going to be. With a bit of marketing money behind it we might even manage to ensure that there are thousands of bloodthirsty would-be conquerors all trying to kill each other shortly after launch.

For backers, it means you get all the cool rewards that being a backer gets! Most backers are going to start the game with a big collection of battledroids and turrets and other defences, and a pile of gold. Some even more generous backers are going to have custom skins that only backers get. And yet other backers with until-recently bulging wallets burning a hole in their trousers will even have exclusive skins that they designed themselves or even ... entire battledroids designed to their own specification!

All the backers also get special badges of recognition, marking you out as being awesome and more attractive than other more ordinary people, and they will be proudly displayed on your profile for all to see, and covet wistfully with feelings of regret on missing out.

As a token of our gratitude to all of our backers, they will now also be getting this exclusive Self-Propelled Exploding Chicken unit!

It's your last chance!

If some of this stuff sounds appealing to you, you've got just 48 hours as of posting this announcement to get in on the action and get all the cool things for way, way less than it'll eventually cost when the game is released! Get thee to the Kickstarter at once and pledge some cash to get in on the action while it's insanely good value.

notes.title: BATTLEDROID KICKSTARTER now LIVE!
notes.content:
After 14 years in development...
...off-and-on, we're finally ready to release BATTLEDROID to the teeming masses. However we need a little bit of help to get it over the line, and this is where you can help make it happen.

Head on over to the Kickstarter and chuck a bit of cash our way - there's reward tiers for everybody's pocket.

[previewyoutube=MPuy7bm3MsI;full][/previewyoutube]

Off to an amazing start
So far the Kickstarter is 25% funded in just 24 hours - I think we're going to make it! But we can't rest on our laurels - success is not guaranteed, and it's only going to happen if more of you can support us enough to reach our funding goal!
